Episode 1953 of the Joe Rogan Experience brings Duncan Trussell back for his mystic comedy hour. By this point Trussell's visits followed a beloved rhythm: jokes first, then real talk about life's biggest questions. Neither man bothers with a plan, and that is the point.

Trussell riffs on love, death, and enlightenment in his warm, wandering style. He mixes cartoon humor with sincere wonder about what it all means. Rogan laughs, shares his own views, and keeps his friend loosely on track. For the faithful, it is another hour of laughs and light from the show's favorite regular.
